# ResearchAudio Evidence Lab

ResearchAudio publishes evidence-led AI briefings for engineers and builders.

## Free tools

- AI Launch Evidence Scorecard: https://tools.researchaudio.io/
  Seven checks for deciding whether an AI product launch provides reproducible, decision-ready evidence.
- AI Cost per Successful Task Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-cost-calculator/
  Calculates AI workflow cost after retries, failure probability, and human review.
- AI Agent Loop Diagnostic: https://tools.researchaudio.io/agent-loop-diagnostic/
  Ten checks for termination, validation, recovery, tracing, budgets, and human escalation.
- AI Task Fit Diagnostic: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-task-fit-diagnostic/
  Eight checks for target clarity, independent judging, timely error signals, safe intervention, bounded execution, and human ownership of premise changes.
- AI Agent ROI Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-agent-roi-calculator/
  Stress-tests automation ROI after failed tasks, human review, usage cost, recurring cost, and implementation payback.
- LLM API Cost Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/llm-api-cost-calculator/
  Estimates monthly LLM API spend from input and output tokens, current prices, prompt caching, retry overhead, and attached per-request costs.
- Prompt Caching Cost Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/prompt-caching-calculator/
  Calculates cache-read and cache-write spend, monthly savings, and the break-even cache hit rate from current user-supplied prices.
- Codex CLI config.toml Generator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/codex-config-generator/
  Generates project_doc_fallback_filenames and project_doc_max_bytes settings while explaining the AGENTS.md resolution order.
- Codex exec Command Builder: https://tools.researchaudio.io/codex-exec-command-builder/
  Builds a shell-safe codex exec command for JSONL events, ephemeral sessions, sandbox selection, response schemas, last-message files, and deliberate non-Git execution.
- Voice AI Latency Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/voice-ai-latency-calculator/
  Estimates time to first audio across endpoint detection, transcript finalization, parallel fast and slow model branches, text-to-speech, and playout.
- AI Voice Agent Cost Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/voice-ai-cost-calculator/
  Calculates loaded cost per AI-resolved call across platform, telephony, STT, TTS, LLM, fixed fees, failed resolutions, and human handoffs.
- LLM GPU Memory Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/llm-gpu-memory-calculator/
  Estimates model-weight VRAM, optional architecture-aware KV cache, runtime headroom, usable memory per GPU, and minimum GPU count.
- Local LLM GPU Compatibility Checker: https://tools.researchaudio.io/local-llm-gpu-compatibility/
  Checks 7B, 13B, 32B, and 70B weight floors against common 8 GB to 141 GB GPU profiles before handing the selected state to the architecture-aware calculator.
- What LLM Can I Run on My GPU?: https://tools.researchaudio.io/what-llm-can-i-run/
  Starts with available GPU memory and returns the largest listed model-size tier below a transparent INT4, INT8, or FP16 weight-floor ceiling.
- LLM KV Cache Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/kv-cache-calculator/
  Calculates exact KV-cache memory per token, sequence, context window, and concurrent request, plus GQA savings and full-context capacity.
- Free AI Evaluation Starter Kit: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-evidence-starter-kit/
  A signup-gated preview of four browser-local tests for launch evidence, operating cost, agent reliability, and automation ROI.
- Embeddable AI Tools: https://tools.researchaudio.io/embeds/
  Generates copy-ready, source-attributed iframe widgets for sixteen browser-local calculators, model finders, diagnostics, builders, and checklists.
- ResearchAudio Partner Distribution Kit: https://tools.researchaudio.io/partners/
  Generates a publication-attributed Beehiiv Magic Link, a universal starter-kit URL, and copy-ready newsletter placements for free publisher cross-promotion.

## Field guides

- The Fable 5 Cost Playbook: https://tools.researchaudio.io/fable-playbook/
  A free 10-page July 2026 field guide to model routing, effort controls, prompt caching, context discipline, batch execution, and spend caps.
- Voice AI Cost per Minute: https://tools.researchaudio.io/voice-ai-cost-per-minute/
  A vendor-neutral formula for stack cost per minute, monthly AI spend, human handoffs, and loaded cost per resolved call.
- AI Receptionist Cost Worksheet: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-receptionist-cost/
  Three editable call-handling scenarios plus a measurement checklist for comparing AI and human outcome cost.
- 7B vs 13B LLM GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/7b-vs-13b-llm-gpu-requirements/
  Compares INT4, INT8, and FP16 weight floors with explicit 32K GQA and MHA KV-cache examples, runtime headroom, and editable GPU plans.
- 70B LLM GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/70b-llm-gpu-requirements/
  Compares INT4, INT8, and FP16 through explicit weight, KV-cache, runtime-headroom, and usable-VRAM assumptions.
- RTX 3060 12GB Local LLM Guide: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-3060-llm-models/
  Shows why the generic 14B INT4 weight tier does not guarantee a full deployment fit, with exact Qwen3 8B, Qwen3 14B, and gpt-oss-20b context-memory scenarios.
- RTX 4060 8GB Local LLM Guide: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-4060-llm-models/
  Shows how Qwen3 8B moves from a comfortable 4K and 8K INT4 fit to 16K and 32K full-cache shortfalls on the 8GB card.
- RTX 4060 Ti 16GB Local LLM Guide: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-4060-ti-16gb-llm-models/
  Verifies the 16GB variant before testing Qwen3 14B, gpt-oss-20b, and Qwen3 8B INT8 at the narrow one-card boundary.
- RTX 3090 vs RTX 4090 Local LLM Comparison: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-3090-vs-4090-local-llm/
  Shows why both 24GB cards share the same model-fit ceiling, then separates VRAM capacity from workload-specific throughput and total system value.
- RTX 4090 Local LLM Guide: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-4090-llm-models/
  Shows what model-size tiers clear a 24 GB card, then tests Qwen3 14B, 30B-A3B, 32B, gpt-oss-20b, and a 70B floor with editable architecture-aware scenarios.
- RTX 5060 Ti 8GB vs 16GB Local LLM Comparison: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-5060-ti-8gb-vs-16gb-local-llm/
  Compares exact Qwen3 and gpt-oss planning scenarios to show where the 16GB variant's doubled VRAM changes the local-LLM boundary.
- RTX 5080 Local LLM Guide: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-5080-llm-models/
  Shows what the 16 GB tier changes, including the narrow Qwen3 14B and short-context gpt-oss-20b planning boundaries.
- RTX 5090 Local LLM Guide: https://tools.researchaudio.io/rtx-5090-llm-models/
  Shows what changes at 32 GB, including the narrow Qwen3 32B 32K fit, a conservative 128K gpt-oss-20b profile, and the remaining 70B shortfall.
- Qwen2.5 GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/qwen2-5-gpu-requirements/
  Compares Qwen2.5 7B, 32B, and 72B across INT4, INT8, and BF16 with official architecture inputs, exact 32K KV-cache math, and 128K context scenarios.
- Qwen3 GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/qwen3-gpu-requirements/
  Compares Qwen3 8B, 14B, 32B, and 30B-A3B across INT4, INT8, and BF16 with exact cache math, dense-versus-MoE boundaries, and Qwen's first-party memory benchmarks.
- DeepSeek V4 Flash GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/deepseek-v4-flash-gpu-requirements/
  Sizes the official V4 Flash 0731 release and its 155.43 GiB mixed FP4 and FP8 artifact, separates 284B total from 13B active parameters, and opens editable 32K, 128K, 384K, and 1M deployment comparisons.
- GLM-5.2 GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/glm-5-2-gpu-requirements/
  Sizes the official 703.74 GiB FP8 artifact, proves why eight 80 GiB GPUs are short, and separates the supported 8xH200 baseline, 8xB200 full-context recipe, and 1,403.19 GiB BF16 artifact.
- Kimi K3 GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/kimi-k3-gpu-requirements/
  Sizes the official 1,453.74 GiB MXFP4 artifact, proves why eight H200-class GPUs are short, and separates the 12xH200 raw weight floor from Moonshot's 64-plus-accelerator serving recommendation.
- Gemma 4 GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/gemma-4-gpu-requirements/
  Compares Google's official E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B inference-memory estimates at BF16, SFP8, and Q4_0, then cross-checks the exact 12B BF16 and QAT Q4_0 files.
- DiffusionGemma GPU Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/diffusiongemma-gpu-requirements/
  Sizes the official 48.10 GiB Google BF16 and 17.53 GiB NVIDIA NVFP4 checkpoints, separates 25.2B resident from 3.8B active parameters, and keeps 256K context outside the weight-only claim.
- gpt-oss Hardware Requirements: https://tools.researchaudio.io/gpt-oss-hardware-requirements/
  Compares gpt-oss-20b and gpt-oss-120b using official checkpoint sizes, MXFP4 weight math, architecture-aware KV-cache estimates, and editable 4K and 128K deployment scenarios.
- AI Agent Security Checklist: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-agent-security-checklist/
  A browser-local 12-point control review for goal hijacking, least privilege, approval gates, sandboxing, untrusted input, tool and MCP provenance, secrets, validation, resource limits, audit trails, shutdown, and recovery.
- AI Benchmark Audit Checklist: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-benchmark-audit-checklist/
  A browser-local 12-point audit for benchmark versioning, exact model snapshots, scaffolds, budgets, environments, grading, task distribution, contamination, uncertainty, baselines, artifacts, cost, and latency.
